speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing fatigue, lower leg swelling, and weight loss; to begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urinary output, such as foamy urine or frequent nighttime urination?

speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age, chronic bronchitis, and recent onset of bilateral leg swelling with weight loss, could you clarify if you have noticed any foamy urine or a decrease in urine volume? Additionally, do you have a history of hypertension or diabetes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Lower leg swelling, Unintentional weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome secondary to Membranous Nephropathy.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Albumin, Total Protein, and Renal Function Panel (BUN/Creatinine).
REQUEST IMAGES: Kidney Ultrasound.
